title: Rick E NDE 22100
content: At the age of five, my father had to slam on the brakes. I hit my head on the gear shifter of the car. The next thing I knew, I was floating about thirty feet above the car. After that, my mother was shaking me to wake up. I had a big bruise on my forehead for days afterward. I thought it was a dream until I started learning about astral projection. My question was, ‘How many five year olds know what a street and Chevrolet look like from thirty feet up?’ After studying the subject of astral projection, I learned how to wake up my consciousness in a dream. After practicing dreaming this way, I would often wake up vibrating extensively. After weeks of this happening, I gave into the vibrations. I was floating across the room. It seemed as if I could see in all directions or was at least aware of what was around me. I could feel a little wind pushing me when I moved. I did not have much control in my movements. I did not do this again. I woke up in the vibration stage many times afterward. The last time I did, I prayed that it would go away. I did from that day on and never came back.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes Accident Car had to slam on brakes, I hit head on gear shifter at the age of 5. From 15 until 19, I would wake up in the vibration stage after practicing lucid dreaming. Life threatening event, but not clinical death I was in a car accident at age 5. I learned how to leave my body and practiced it from the age of 15 until the age of 19. In the first instance.
elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: Yes I was consciousness separate from my physical body.
elements.Please compare your hearing during the e: From age of 15 to 19, I was hearing an extremely loud rumbling noise until I left my body, then peace. It seemed that when I moved, I could hear a small wind as well as feel it help me move.
elements.Did you seem to enter some other, uneart: A clearly mystical or unearthly realm
elements.What emotions did you feel during the ex: I was scared during the vibration stage until I let go. Then I was at peace. Not long after, I was excited.
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: No My sister shut the door to my room while I was out of my body, I snapped back in when she did this.
elements.God, Spiritual and Religion: point of no return? No My sister shut the door to my room while I was out of my body, I snapped back in when she did this. God, Spiritual and Religion
elements.After the NDE: change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? Yes I believed more spiritually. After the NDE
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: The vibration stage was the most intense feeling I have ever felt.
elements.At any time in your life, has anything e: Yes Sometimes while laying in the bath, I can hear the vibrations far into the background.
